reviewContext.userProblem: ART reads 23 followed X accounts through the built-in riela/x-collect add-on with one `from:a OR from:b` search per run. X pay-per-use bills each returned post ($0.005), deduplicated only within a UTC day. Two prolific accounts (@rohanpaul_ai 26, @Polymarket 24 of the last 18 h window) used two thirds of the page budget and drove cost until the user's X spend cap was hit. Nested quote/repost expansions to depth 2 and cross-UTC-day re-reads add further billable reads.
requiredOutcomes: authorSampling option: handle (case-insensitive) -> probability in [0,1]; sampled handles removed from the regular author query and its checkpoint; deterministic draw SHA-256(lowercase handle + canonical end) < probability; drawn handles read in a separate group for [start,end] only (fresh scan, no cursor, no earliest widening), posts merged with the same shape.

authorDailyPostThreshold option: checkpoint keeps a compact rolling per-author daily count for the regular query; authors above the threshold are auto-sampled at min(1, threshold/observedDailyVolume); explicit authorSampling overrides; auto set changes at most once per day.
A sampling-, depth- or query-induced change of the regular query never produces an invalid-cursor failure and never triggers a 24 h re-read; it starts fresh coverage from start.
Output metadata `sampling` lists sampled handles with source, probability, observed volume, drawn/skipped status, fetchedCount and truncated; output size limits kept.
Validation rejects probabilities outside [0,1], handles not in authorHandles, duplicate case-insensitive keys, threshold < 1 (and > 100000), referenceDepth outside 0..2 or combined with select.
referenceDepth option (0/1/2, default 2 byte-identical to today) limits nested quote/repost/author fields and expansions; checkpoint reference_depth identity resets coverage on change.
UTC-day aware re-reads: resumed/widened scans do not re-request posts older than the current UTC day that a completed coverage already contains (suffix/prefix segments around the covered range H).
usageTweets: expose GET /2/usage/tweets via the linked x-gateway SDK if its SDL has a usage field (fixture-tested through riela/x-gateway-reader); otherwise document why in the design doc and skip.
README documents the cost controls with one JSON example and the per-UTC-day dedup rule.
nonGoals: No change to lookup mode (XLookupCollection.swift) or to XCollectionOptions.postFields(depth:links:coverage:).
No REST client or Package.swift bump for usage; no real X API calls in tests.
No persistence outside the returned checkpoint.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Wave 1 contract plan xs-01 pins all new XCollectionOptions fields (authorSampling, authorDailyPostThreshold, referenceDepth, customSelection, billingDayStart, depthIdentity), postFields(level:referenceDepth:links:coverage:), the reference_depth checkpoint identity and a window.needsRequest seam.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: xs-02 and xs-03 build on fixed shapes in wave 2 without editing XCollectionOptions.swift, keeping per-wave write sets disjoint.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Deterministic draw uses the first 8 bytes of SHA-256(lowercase(handle) + "\n" + canonical ISO8601 end) / 2^64, never Hasher.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reproducible across processes and testable; Hasher is per-process seeded.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Billing day D is the UTC start of the execution clock's day (options.billingDayStart), never derived from end or options.timezone; H = [max(cs,start), min(ce,end,D)) is skipped via suffix/prefix segments.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: X dedup resets at UTC midnight; posts in a previous UTC day's completed coverage would be billed again.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: usageTweets is only exposed if the pinned x-gateway SDL already has a usage Query field, through the existing riela/x-gateway-reader; otherwise documented as absent.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Riela calls X only through the linked SDK; a riela REST path would break the single-SDK rule and an SDK change is outside this repository.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Plan review accepted XS-PLAN-H1 resolved: every writePaths entry is one concrete file, sharedPaths [] and artifactRoots [] in all plans; per-wave writePaths disjoint; XCollectionWindow.swift and ProductionNodeAdapter+XCollect.swift ordered by dependsOn on xs-01.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reviewer parsed all four JSON headers with python3 -I and checked git status (step5-impl-plan-review, comm-000012).

intentionalTradeoffs: xs-02 and xs-03 both run full `swift build --build-tests` in the same tree in wave 2; a half-finished edit in one can break the other's build; both record and rerun, and the integration gate runs the combined filter.

When sampling changes author_query the window resets to config_key and loses prior coverage, so on that one run xs-02 cannot exclude H and previous-UTC-day posts in [start,end) may be billed once more (design: fresh coverage from start, no 24 h re-read).
Sampled reads are 1 page (maxResults = pageSize) per drawn group; a leftover token is not persisted and is reported as truncated.
The auto-sampled set is frozen per calendar day in options.timezone to keep the regular query/checkpoint stable.
supportedEdgeCases: All handles sampled: no regular search, minimal checkpoint with author_query "" and complete coverage.
Sampled read failure: failures entry with stage "sampled", run succeeds, complete reflects regular query only.
Malformed previous.author_sampling with threshold set: invalid before any search; without threshold the key is dropped.
Replayed completed window does not double count observed volumes; truncated sampled page counts only [t_old,end).
Depth change with a pending token: no nextToken/sinceId sent, startTime = wire(start); legacy checkpoints without reference_depth keep continuing at depth 2.
Suffix/prefix segment switches, zero-page failures and budget stops persist a validated pending_scan and never request H.
billingDayStart nil (direct window construction): legacy behavior.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Billing of included/expanded objects (undocumented by X; assumed possibly billed).
Adding usage endpoints to the x-gateway SDK itself.

acceptanceCriteria: XCollectionOptions exposes authorSampling [String: Double]?, authorDailyPostThreshold Int?, referenceDepth Int (default 2), customSelection Bool, billingDayStart Date? and computed depthIdentity Int? with the exact names/types in the plan.

Validation rejects referenceDepth 3, -1, "2", 1.5, referenceDepth with select, unknown/duplicate/out-of-range/non-numeric authorSampling entries, non-object authorSampling, threshold 0, 100001, 2.5; accepts {"BOB":0}, {"bob":1}, {"bob":0.25}, threshold 1.
referenceDepth 2/absent default selection is byte-identical to postFields(depth:0,links:coverage:) for all four links/coverage combos; depth 1 and 0 produce the expected nested sets.

A depth change resets coverage from start with no nextToken/sinceId; same depth continues the token; legacy checkpoints keep working and gain no reference_depth key; invalid previous.reference_depth is rejected before any search.
Collector sets billingDayStart (UTC day of clock) on each group window and the read loop uses window.needsRequest.
XCollectionTests.swift and XLookupCollection.swift unchanged; existing XCollectionTests and XLookupCollectionTests pass unmodified.
Fresh windows whose previous complete coverage overlaps a previous UTC day compute H = [max(cs,start), min(ce,end,D)) and never request it; empty H keeps today's exact behavior and bytes.
Suffix/prefix segments with skip/segment keys, correct startTime/endTime/sinceId arguments, segment-scoped accept filter, and a segment switch that resets token/visited/page_count.
needsRequest, finalization (pending_scan persisted until both segments finish, since_id committed only on completion) and pending validation follow the plan; legacy scans unchanged byte-for-byte.
Design assertions 1-7 and 9-12 exist as named passing tests in XCollectionUTCDayTests; billingDayStart nil keeps legacy behavior; existing XCollectionTests and XCollectionReferenceDepthTests green.
drawValue is deterministic per (handle, end), case-insensitive, SHA-256 based (no Hasher); 4000 ends at p=0.25 give a drawn fraction in [0.22,0.28]; p=0 never, p=1 always.

Sampled handles are absent from every regular search query, author_query and checkpoint; drawn handles get a separate search for [start,end] only with no nextToken/sinceId, maxResults = pageSize; posts merged with the normal shape; leftover token reported truncated and not persisted.
Threshold 10 with 40 posts/86400 s on a new day gives auto p = 0.25 (source auto); explicit entry overrides (source explicit); auto set frozen within the same day; replay does not double count.
A sampling-induced query change with a pending token for the old query gives no invalid-cursor error and a fresh scan from start without nextToken.

Sampled read failure is recorded with stage sampled and does not fail the run; all-handles-sampled yields no regular search and a minimal complete checkpoint; malformed author_sampling state handled per plan.
Without authorSampling/authorDailyPostThreshold the output has no sampling key and the checkpoint equals the pre-change checkpoint; existing tests green.
